decisions.reason: As a core door lever handle family that fits the firm's established system offering and shows no visible sign of underperformance, it is likely to be retained.

The mitred handle family appears strategically consistent with the firm's design-led range, though its more style-specific positioning makes it somewhat more vulnerable to later portfolio pruning if demand is only average.
A multifunctional door lever handle supports the firm's accessibility and coordinated-solution strategy, so absent evidence of a shortfall management would likely continue it.
This door lever handle line sits squarely in the firm's core competence and there is no indication that results have fallen below aspiration levels enough to trigger withdrawal.
Its dedicated presentation and German Design Award signal performance above aspiration and strong external validation, making discontinuation very unlikely.
The new bronze finish extends the range coherently but finishes can be rationalized more easily than whole hardware families, so it carries the highest—though still minority—drop risk.
